items.summary: is now available on AI Gateway for free through November 13, 2026.Ampersand from Humans&Ampersand is a language model built to take part in group conversations, such as a team chat, and to decide on each turn whether to speak or stay quiet. It is designed to understand individual and shared goals, help people work through disagreements, and recognize when a contribution would be useful. That can mean asking a clarifying question, sharing relevant context, or waiting while people respond to one another.Your application exposes these actions as caller-defined .  delivers a contribution, while  leaves the conversation quiet until the next human message.
